scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @meridian/contracts && npm run build -w @meridian/kernel && npm run build -w @meridian/nest-kit
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w identity-service && npm run build -w catalog-service && npm run build -w inventory-service && npm run build -w checkout-service && npm run build -w payment-service && npm run build -w notification-service && npm run build -w search-worker && npm run build -w analytics-service && bash scripts/copy-prisma.sh
scripts.docker:build: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml --profile core --profile apps build
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml --profile core --profile apps up -d --wait identity-service catalog-service inventory-service checkout-service payment-service notification-service search-worker analytics-service storefront
scripts.docker:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml --profile core --profile apps rm --stop --force migrate identity-service catalog-service inventory-service checkout-service payment-service notification-service search-worker analytics-service storefront
scripts.docker:seed: IDENTITY_URL=http://localhost:13001 CATALOG_URL=http://localhost:13012 INVENTORY_URL=http://localhost:13003 CHECKOUT_URL=http://localhost:13004 bash scripts/seed.sh
